Calibration Values

0.1 cc.dx - section 7.1

p <- calib_plot_infos[["cc.dx"]]
make_calib_plot(d_outs, p)

col_names <- paste0(c("Black", "Hispanic", "White/Other"), "MSM")
row_names <- c(
  "Target Statistic: Diagnosed Fraction",
  "Simulations: Diagnosed Fractions (med [IQR])",
  "Calibrated Rates (per Week)",
  "Mean Inter-Test Interval (Years)"#,
  # "Median Diagnostic Delay (Years)"
)

fmtr <- scales::label_percent(0.1)
tar_names <- paste0("cc.dx.", races_names)
tar <- targets[tar_names] |> fmtr()
p_names <- paste0("hiv.test.rate")
prms <- param[[p_names]] |> scales::label_scientific()()
m_int <- (1 / param[[p_names]] / 52) |> scales::label_number(0.1)()
# med_diag_delays <- d_outs |>
#   filter(time > max(time) - year_steps) |>
#   select(sim, starts_with("med_diag_delay_")) |>
#   group_by(sim) |>
#   summarise(across(everything(), mean)) |>
#   select(-sim) |>
#   mutate(across(everything(), \(x) x / year_steps)) |>
#   summarise(across(everything(), \(x) med_iqr(x, scales::label_number(0.01)))) |>
#   as.character()

sim_vals <- d_outs |>
  filter(time > max(time) - year_steps) |>
  select(sim, all_of(tar_names)) |>
  group_by(sim) |>
  summarise(across(everything(), mean)) |>
  select(-sim) |>
  summarise(across(everything(), \(x) med_iqr(x, fmtr))) |>
  as.character()



# tbl <- rbind(tar, sim_vals,  prms, m_int, med_diag_delays)
tbl <- rbind(tar, sim_vals,  prms, m_int)
rownames(tbl) <- row_names
colnames(tbl) <- col_names

knitr::kable(tbl)
BlackMSM HispanicMSM White/OtherMSM
Target Statistic: Diagnosed Fraction 84.7% 81.8% 86.2%
Simulations: Diagnosed Fractions (med [IQR]) 88.4% [88.2%-88.6%] 85.6% [84.6%-86.5%] 89.8% [89.5%-90.1%]
Calibrated Rates (per Week) 1.50e-03 1.47e-03 1.47e-03
Mean Inter-Test Interval (Years) 12.8 13.1 13.1

0.2 cc.linked1m - section 7.2

p <- calib_plot_infos[["cc.linked1m"]]
make_calib_plot(d_outs, p)

col_names <- paste0(c("Black", "Hispanic", "White/Other"), "MSM")
row_names <- c(
  "Target Statistic: Fraction Linked within 1m",
  "Simulations: Fraction Linked (med [IQR])",
  "Calibrated Rates (per Week)",
  "Mean Time to ART (in Weeks)"
)

fmtr <- scales::label_percent(0.1)
tar_names <- paste0("cc.linked1m.", races_names)
tar <- targets[tar_names] |> fmtr()
p_names <- paste0("tx.init.rate")
prms <- param[[p_names]] |> scales::label_scientific()()
mean_time_to_art <- scales::label_number(0.1)(1 / param[[p_names]])

sim_vals <- d_outs |>
  filter(time > max(time) - year_steps) |>
  select(sim, all_of(tar_names)) |>
  group_by(sim) |>
  summarise(across(everything(), mean)) |>
  select(-sim) |>
  summarise(across(everything(), \(x) med_iqr(x, fmtr))) |>
  as.character()

tbl <- rbind(tar, sim_vals,  prms, mean_time_to_art)
rownames(tbl) <- row_names
colnames(tbl) <- col_names

knitr::kable(tbl)
BlackMSM HispanicMSM White/OtherMSM
Target Statistic: Fraction Linked within 1m 82.9% 89.8% 88.1%
Simulations: Fraction Linked (med [IQR]) 82.8% [82.6%-83.1%] 89.8% [88.9%-90.5%] 88.1% [87.7%-88.5%]
Calibrated Rates (per Week) 2.98e-01 3.68e-01 3.48e-01
Mean Time to ART (in Weeks) 3.4 2.7 2.9
